title: Tibo's 7-step playbook for building a business in 2025
summary: Tibo lays out a seven-step path from finding your edge to fixing retention. Ideas, not building, are the bottleneck now, so validate demand with a fake landing page, build in one week, find the real problem, scale acquisition fast, then obsess over retention.

principles.text: Business success starts with being better than others at something; find your unfair advantage first.
principles.quote: “You have to be better than others at something.”

principles.text: Building is no longer the bottleneck; knowing what to build is. Collect ideas from complaints and requests.
principles.quote: Building is not a bottleneck any more. Knowing what to build is.

principles.text: Validate demand before coding: a landing page with an email input. No emails, skip the idea.
principles.quote: If people drop their email = validation. No interest? Skip to next idea.

principles.text: Force a one-week build constraint to narrow to the core value proposition, then ship to real people.
principles.quote: Why!? 👉 It will force your to narrow it down to its core value proposition.

principles.text: The problem you think you solve is usually not the real one; most reduce to money, health, or relationships/status.
principles.quote: The problem you think you're solving usually isn't the real one.

principles.text: Retention matters more than acquisition; it is how a business compounds.
